description_detailed: Celebrating the 30th anniversary of the Lion King film in 2024, this miniset presents the birth of Simba. Limited to 500 copies, this miniset features the three new 10, 20 and 50 centime denominations in Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) quality.This set contains all 8 French circulating denominations in Brilliant uncirculated (BU) quality. The €1 coin is minted exclusively for Miniset and proof quality series and will not be minted in circulating quality in 2024.
